::: {.page-hero}
::: {.page-hero-copy}
# 12-week study roadmap

Use this page to convert the full module track into weekly cycles: read, run script, compare output, write one technical decision.
:::

::: {.page-hero-aside}
**Suggested rhythm**

1 module per week with one evidence output.
:::
:::

::: {.route-overview role="region" aria-label="Study phases"}
::: {.route-overview-copy}
## Phase rhythm

Follow progression from foundations to genomics while keeping each week tied to one verifiable output.
:::

::: {.route-overview-grid}
::: {.route-overview-card}
**Weeks 1-2**

Foundations of breeding and quantitative genetics.
:::
::: {.route-overview-card}
**Weeks 3-6**

Data exploration, variance, heritability, repeatability and correlations.
:::
::: {.route-overview-card}
**Weeks 7-9**

Modeling, BLUP, pedigree and relationship interpretation.
:::
::: {.route-overview-card}
**Weeks 10-12**

SNPs, quality control, GWAS and genomic prediction.
:::
:::
:::

| Week | Topic | Practice |
|---:|---|---|
| 1 | [Module 01](../../modules/modulo01-introducao-ao-melhoramento-animal.qmd) | Run `scripts/modulo01.R` and compare selection groups. |
| 2 | [Module 02](../../modules/modulo02-bases-da-genetica-quantitativa.qmd) | Connect phenotype, breeding value and environment. |
| 3 | [Module 03](../../modules/modulo03-estatistica-descritiva-e-exploracao-de-dados-no-r.qmd) | Describe distribution and dispersion in simulated data. |
| 4 | [Module 04](../../modules/modulo04-medias-variancias-e-componentes-de-variancia.qmd) | Interpret variance-source changes. |
| 5 | [Module 05](../../modules/modulo05-herdabilidade-e-repetibilidade.qmd) | Test sensitivity of heritability estimates. |
| 6 | [Module 06](../../modules/modulo06-correlacoes-geneticas-e-fenotipicas.qmd) | Discuss correlated responses to selection. |
| 7 | [Module 07](../../modules/modulo07-modelos-lineares-e-modelos-mistos.qmd) | Separate fixed and random effects. |
| 8 | [Module 08](../../modules/modulo08-blup-e-avaliacao-genetica.qmd) | Interpret candidate ranking with BLUP outputs. |
| 9 | [Module 09](../../modules/modulo09-estrutura-de-pedigree-e-parentesco.qmd) | Evaluate pedigree impact on comparisons. |
| 10 | [Module 10](../../modules/modulo10-introducao-a-genomica-e-marcadores-snp.qmd) | Revisit SNP integration in workflow. |
| 11 | [Module 11](../../modules/modulo11-controle-de-qualidade-de-dados-genomicos.qmd) | Define genomic quality filters. |
| 12 | [Module 12](../../modules/modulo12-matrizes-genomicas-gwas-e-predicao-genomica.qmd) | Connect G matrix, GWAS and genomic prediction. |
